rows.quote: We also obtained the association of each SNP in the genetic score with IHD in men in UK Biobank, and with diabetes in a published GWAS of diabetes in men in DIAGRAM52, and used different analytic methods as above, including IVW, weighted median, weighted mode, MR-Egger, MR-PRESSO, and GSMR.
rows.dataset_named_in_source: IHD in men in UK Biobank
rows.coder_note: The IHD outcome associations are the authors' own analysis of men in UK Biobank individual-level data, with a case definition in the next sentence and application numbers 42,468 and 45,052 (rule C); no dictionary row is that analysis. The lipid and glucose outcomes are separately taken from Neale Lab men-only statistics with no round stated, which separates neither Neale lab row.
